title: Trader-restart Telegram ping: selective, sectioned, status headline, cause line, live-trade accounting
note: Lane session_01LtduMwXcSLF2D7F6L3Xgyj. Built: one restart ping (status headline, cause line, per-venue expandable sections, per-account broker-vs-journal reconcile with MEASURED SL/TP), compact 2-line form for a clean deploy/manual restart. Cause evidence: restart-intent marker (deploy/manual/watchdog) + systemd journal of previous exit + host uptime. Tier 2, landing hold. Proposed (NOT built, separate Tier-2 question): keep the trader up across deploys whose runtime diff touches only web-api/other-unit code. MERGED 2026-10-15T09:40Z (PR #18226). NOT yet observed. Closes when: the first trader restart after deploy logs 'boot_audit: restart report' and the Telegram SYSTEM ping shows a cause line 'deploy <sha> (#PR)' (or an evidenced cause), per-account counts matching /api/diag positions, no false ghost/untracked from IB/Alpaca symbol mismatch. If cause reads 'unknown' on a deploy, check journalctl readability for the trader user. Proposed, not built: skip restarting ict-trader-live on deploys that touch no trader-imported code (separate Tier-2).
